description: Realm CRUD with per-realm branding, password policy, token TTLs, enabled methods, and allowed redirect URIs; realm-scoped user pools (same email is distinct principals across realms); realm administrators.

requirements.description: Realms must be fully manageable via CRUD RPCs (create, read, update, delete/disable). Each realm carries: display name, branding (logo URL, colors), password policy (min length, complexity, history), token TTLs (access, refresh), enabled authentication methods, and allowed redirect URIs for OAuth. User accounts are realm-scoped: the same email address is a distinct principal in each realm with no shared credential or session state. Realm administrators are users with admin role scoped to a specific realm.
requirements.deferred_reason: The shipped authenticator intentionally remains default-realm-only; true multi-realm tenant isolation is outside this plan.
requirements.revisit_trigger: A second tenant or household requires independent realm administration and data isolation.
requirements.title: Realm CRUD as True Tenant Boundary with Per-Realm Configuration
